movelist.name: Heal Pulse
movelist.effect: Restores 50% of the target’s max Hit Points. Heal Pulse’s user may not target itself with Heal Pulse.

movelist.name: Fling
movelist.effect: The user throws a held item, determining the effect of Fling.

movelist.name: Sing
movelist.effect: All legal Targets fall Asleep. On a miss, Sing instead causes targets to become Slowed and suffer a -2 penalty to their Evasion until the end of the user’s next turn.

movelist.name: Take Down
movelist.effect: You may perform a Trip Maneuver against the target as a Free Action.

movelist.name: Minimize
movelist.effect: The user gains +4 Evasion, and user’s size is lowered to Small for the remainder of the encounter.

abilities.name: Serene Grace
abilities.effect: The user’s Effect Range is increased by +2.

abilities.name: Natural Cure
abilities.effect: Whenever the user is returned to its Poké Ball or Takes A Breather, it may activate Natural Cure to cure itself of all Persistent Status Afflictions.

abilities.name: Blessed Touch
abilities.effect: An adjacent Pokémon or Trainer gains Hit Points equal to 1/4th of its maximum Hit Points.
